newsitem.title: PERU: Peru central bank offers 30 mln soles 28-day CDs.
newsitem.headline: Peru central bank offers 30 mln soles 28-day CDs.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru announced Thursday the first auction of Certificates of Deposit (CDs) for almost two months, saying it would accept bids for 28-day CDs worth 30 million soles until 1430 local time/1530 EDT BCQZ.
All the certificates have a June 6 starting date.

Before Thursday, the bank had not announced a CD auction since April 10. Last year the bank regularly held auctions on Tuesdays and Thursdays but has limited its sales in 1997 due to a lack of liquidity in the financial system.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
